 Sources: Ubisoft and at least two other gaming companies made offers to Microsoft to acquire the French game developer Arkane Studios   —  Microsoft's gaming unit is looking to divest the French company behind ‘Dishonored’ and 'Marvel's Blade'  —  Multiple companies have made offers …
